faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RNU DDK Bengaluru Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Casual Assignee posts is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Casual Assignee posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Casual Assignee posts announced by Regional News Unit Doordarshan Kendra Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Casual Assignee posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 1125 to Rs. 3000 Per Day, depending on the specific post and shift.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 50 years for all the posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Test followed by an Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any application fees for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category, including SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the educational qualification required for the CG Operator post?
faq.answer: For the CG Operator post, candidates need to have completed 10+2 from a Recognized Board and possess a Certificate in Computer Application.

faq.question: Q9. Is proficiency in Kannada language a requirement for all posts?
faq.answer: Proficiency in Kannada Language is a specific requirement for the Anchor post. Other posts may have desirable qualifications related to language.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for RNU DDK Bengaluru Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
